name: gizza-ai/decimal-to-fraction
summary: Convert decimals to exact or approximate fractions.

tool.description: Convert a decimal into an exact fraction, mixed number, or simplest approximation within a tolerance or denominator cap. Supports repeating decimals, percentages, scientific notation, fixed denominators, rounding up/down/nearest, and optional fraction reduction. Returns JSON with numerator, denominator, mixed number, exactness, error, convergents and worked steps.

decimal.description: Decimal number to convert. Accepts signs, thousands separators, percentages, scientific notation, and repeating notation such as 0.1(6).

denominator.description: Optional fixed denominator to snap onto, such as 16 for nearest sixteenth or 100 for nearest hundredth.

max_denominator.description: Optional maximum denominator for continued-fraction approximation. Use 0 for no cap.

reduce.description: Reduce the output fraction to lowest terms. Turn off to keep a fixed denominator such as 8/16.

repeating_digits.description: Optional count of trailing decimal digits that repeat when the input does not use parentheses or ellipsis notation.

rounding.description: Rounding direction for approximations: nearest, up (not below the decimal), or down (not above the decimal).

tolerance.description: Optional absolute error tolerance. Use 0 for the exact fraction, or values such as 0.000001 to find the simplest nearby fraction.
